content:
incident-bot: [ALERT] KV cache growth + paging noise detected on us-central-2 serving cluster. Severity: SEV2. See runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/kv-paging

liam (oncall-sre): noticing sustained swap activity on nodes in pool-7; several worker processes being OOM-killed. P95 latency trending up; alerts firing for customers using gpt7b-family.

sam (eng-runtime): quick signal dump: continuous-batching windows increased last night (param: batching.window_ms=120) and kernel-autoselect for quantized candidates enabled in latest rollout. I’m seeing per-request KV allocations spike on quantized_gptq path.

hana (eng-ml): confirmed. The kernel selector started preferring a gptq-int8 kernel when model.sequence_len > 1024 to save cycles. That kernel’s kv-layout uses host_word_size instead of quant_elem_size during buffer sizing when quant flag set -> approx 3-5x larger KV footprint for some sequences.

zoe (support): two paying customers reporting timeouts: org-omega and org-zenith. Zenith reports batch jobs failing intermittently. I’ve opened tickets and got request IDs.

sam (eng-runtime): immediate mitigation plan: 1) disable kernel-autoselect quant path via feature flag 2) shrink continuous batching window to 30ms and cap batch size to 6 3) emergency route: divert high-throughput customers to fp16 model variant (gpt7b-fp16) for write-heavy endpoints.

deploy-bot: executing flag toggle and routing change...
```
> toggle feature kernel_autoselect_quant -> false --env=prod
ok: feature updated in 8/8 router pools
> redwood-router update-route --model gpt7b-family --fallback gpt7b-fp16 --selector high_throughput_customers
ok: routing rule applied
```

sam (eng-runtime): applying runtime knobs to set batching.window_ms=30 and batching.max_batch=6 for gpt7b-family. Rolling reload planned.

deploy-bot: runtime change applied to canaries:
```
canary-pool: 3/3 ok
metrics: batching.size -> down 45% on canaries
kv_bytes/request -> baseline restored on canaries
```

liam (oncall-sre): promoting to prod pools now. Disk spill and swap % falling. OOM events stopped on upgraded nodes.

hana (eng-ml): I'll prepare a targeted kernel patch: fix buffer_size computation to use quantized_element_bytes when quant flag true and add assert in allocator. Building PR now. ETA ~2.5h with canary. Also adding unit test that simulates long sequences > 1024.

sam (eng-runtime): temporary config: for tenants with no strict latency SLO we’ll enforce forced_kv_eviction_on_response=true to reduce long-tail memory. This affects some background jobs but prevents node instability.

deploy-bot: command output:
```
> redwood-cli runtime set /global/forced_kv_eviction_on_response true --env=prod
applied: yes
affected nodes: 96
```

zoe (support): org-omega: error rate peaked at 18% between 03:04-03:28 UTC; median latency jumped to 9s. zenith: batch job failure rate 22% in same window. Both report partial recovery after routing change. Sending interim status messages.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE (10m): mitigations applied, impact reduced. Continuing to monitor.

hana (eng-ml): CI is green for allocator fix. Pushing canary image sha=197b2c-fix-kvsize.

deploy-bot: deploying canary sha=197b2c to pool us-central-2-canary:
```
canary nodes: 4/4 healthy
kv_bytes/request on canary: stable at baseline
no regressions detected in p99 latency
```

sam (eng-runtime): canary looks good. Scheduling full rollout in 12m. Also increasing garbage-collector aggressiveness on older nodes to reclaim leaked buffers.

liam (oncall-sre): rolling rollout started: 0% -> 30% -> 70% -> 100% over 22m. Paging alerts cleared; no new OOMs reported.

incident-bot: SEV2 -> MONITORING. Postmortem owner: hana (eng-ml).

aman (product): need customer-facing summary for legal/CS. Zoe, can you prepare: affected window, percentage of requests impacted per org, what we changed, and ETA for permanent fixes? Due in 2h.

zoe (support): on it. Draft will list org-omega and org-zenith, include ticket refs, and invite customers to a tech postmortem if requested.

hana (eng-ml): follow-ups and action items:
- hana: postmortem + RCA with timeline and code pointers (due 48h)
- sam: add perf gate to deploy pipeline that verifies kv_bytes/request doesn't increase >15% on quant paths (due 72h)
- eng-sre: alert tuning: add an alert for avg_kv_bytes/request > baseline*1.25 for 5m (due 24h)
- deploy: add rollout flag to prevent enabling kernel_autoselect_quant without perf gate in prod (due 48h)

sam (eng-runtime): also recommend a new canary metric: quant_kernel_kv_ratio to catch allocator regressions early. Will prototype.

liam (oncall-sre): handing off follow-ups to sam/hana at 04:30 UTC. I'll remain on-call for escalation. Good job team. :thumbsup: 

incident-bot: Thread remains open for postmortem link. Temporary knobs: kernel_autoselect_quant disabled; forced_kv_eviction_on_response=true until cluster healthy for 4h; routing fallback active for high-throughput tenants.

sam (eng-runtime): creating postmortem doc now and will link here once ready.

zoe (support): interim customer messages sent. Monitoring shows both orgs back to baseline for error rate and latency.

incident-bot: Incident mitigated; monitoring continues. End of thread.
